text.C1_sample_adequacy: n_in_domain >= 100, n_out_of_domain >= 50, and at least 25 out-of-domain queries in each of dev and test
text.C2_separation_pooled: AUROC (probability that a random in-domain rank-1 similarity exceeds a random out-of-domain one, ties 0.5) >= 0.90 AND some threshold t has in-domain refusal rate <= 0.05 AND out-of-domain acceptance rate <= 0.20 on the pooled set
text.C3_held_out: t* = on DEV only: among candidate thresholds (midpoints between adjacent distinct DEV scores) with DEV in-domain refusal rate <= 0.05, the one with the lowest DEV out-of-domain acceptance rate (ties: the lowest t). On TEST, t* must give in-domain refusal rate <= 0.10 and out-of-domain acceptance rate <= 0.25
text.acceptance_semantics: a query is accepted when rank-1 similarity >= t (inclusive); refused when below
text.not_gates: ambiguous queries, the five legacy out-of-domain questions, the gap rank1-rank2, and per-category figures are descriptive only
text.populations: in-domain = Phase 4 (50) + Phase 5 (54) + 7F in-domain; out-of-domain = 7F out_of_domain (the clear ones only)
text.score: rank-1 cosine SIMILARITY = 1 - cosine distance, as returned by the unchanged dense router (no threshold, k=29, rank 1 only)
text.verdict: a threshold is justified only if C1, C2 and C3 all hold, and even then it is indicative (small sample, agent-authored). Otherwise no threshold is justified and min_cosine stays None

scope.score: rank-1 cosine similarity (1 - cosine distance); distance is reported separately in every row
